Market Volatility Sparks Opportunities for Large-Cap Equities

The recent market correction has created opportunities for investors to invest in large-cap equities, according to Sahil Kapoor of DSP Mutual Fund. The sectoral opportunities highlighted include private banks and healthcare. Meanwhile, large-cap mutual funds are struggling to achieve downside risk-adjusted returns. Inflows to multi-asset allocation funds have increased amid stock market volatility.
